Agent Name: InformationExtraction_Expert  
Step Number: 20  
Reason for Mistake: The InformationExtraction_Expert incorrectly concluded that Susan L. Wagner held a C-suite position before joining Apple's Board of Directors. While Susan L. Wagner was a co-founder of BlackRock and served as Vice Chairman and COO, the specific roles she held at the time of joining Apple's Board were not sufficiently verified. This oversight led to the erroneous conclusion that all board members held C-suite positions before joining, which contradicted the task's requirement to identify any member who did not hold such a position. The error stemmed from a failure to adequately verify the timing of her roles relative to her appointment to Apple's Board.
